title: Jesus warned about deception.
paragraphs:
Jesus warned about deception.
Paul warned about people falling asleep spiritually.
Yet today many believers are more distracted than discerning.

Comfort has replaced conviction.
Silence has replaced courage.
But Scripture calls us to something different:
"Let us not sleep, as others do, but let us watch and be sober." (1 Thessalonians 5:6)

A watchman doesn't panic.
A watchman stays awake and sounds the alarm.

The world doesn't need more silent Christians.
It needs believers who walk in truth, love, and boldness.

The question is simple:
Are we awake… or drifting to sleep?
Do you think the Church today is spiritually awake or spiritually distracted?
